reviewer: parent; independent Python arithmetic on recorded numerical geometry; no image viewing
bandCheck: Intersect each recorded band polygon with x=0 and x=W for landscape, or y=0 and y=H for portrait; require a nonzero intersection within each stage edge.
exposureRatioCheck: Euclidean adjacent-edge lengths of each recorded exposure rectangle; target landscape 3/2 and portrait 2/3; tolerance 1e-5.
limitations: Independent checks of recorded numerical samples, not exhaustive frame or image inspection. Full capture, visual provenance, local and public playback remain separate gates.
